full_judgment: "Section 80 of the Evidence Act dispenses with the necessity of the formal proof of statement recorded by a competent Magistrate under section 164 CrPC as there is a presumption that such statement was genuinely recorded by the Magistrate. Such statement recorded by a competent Magistrate under section 164 CrPC can only be used for contradicting him under sections 145 and 155 of the Evidence Act or for the purpose of corroborating him under section 157 CrPC."
